punchline: In The Alchemist, a fight between two hawks saves an oasis, but only because Santiago bets his life on saying what he saw.
thirty_sec: In Paulo Coelho's The Alchemist, Santiago is stuck at a desert oasis where weapons are banned. He watches one hawk attack another and suddenly sees an army riding in. He tells the chieftains. They arm their men, but warn him that if no attack comes, he dies. The next day hundreds of tribesmen ride in with hidden weapons and are beaten. Santiago gets fifty pieces of gold.
